_comment: Demand Lifecycle Workflow · 11 statuses (8 main + 3 side states) + transitions. Apply via REST POST /rest/api/3/workflows/create. After creation, attach to a Workflow Scheme and associate that scheme with DGTLPROD. Note: post-functions, conditions and validators are described inline as _hints — Jira's UI/API may require them to be added separately depending on instance settings. Use the new (modern) workflow endpoint, NOT the legacy XML import.

statuses.name: NEW
statuses.description: Demand just submitted by Requester · awaiting auto-routing

statuses.name: ROUTED
statuses.description: Component set + Lead PM notified · awaiting Gate 1 (Triage)

statuses.name: TRIAGED
statuses.description: Passed Gate 1 · ready for PM Review

statuses.name: ANALYZING
statuses.description: PM + Architect scoring BV/UX/Safety/Effort · A4 will compute Pain Score

statuses.name: BACKLOG
statuses.description: Approved at Gate 2 · ready for execution by squad

statuses.name: IMPLEMENTING
statuses.description: Squad working · WIP-limited per Class of Service

statuses.name: DEFERRED
statuses.description: Out of scope this cycle · re-evaluate next Gate 2

statuses.name: REJECTED
statuses.description: Killed at Gate 2 · will not be done

workflows.name: Demand Lifecycle Workflow
workflows.description: Avangrid Digital Products · Demand intake → triage → portfolio governance → squad delivery. Designed by NTT DATA per TOM v3.

transitions.name: Submit Demand
transitions._hint_post_functions: Set Reporter = current user; assign sponsor; clear all auto fields

transitions.name: A1 Auto-Route
transitions._hint_trigger: Automation A1 fires on Issue Created · sets component + notifies Lead PM
transitions._hint_conditions: issuetype = Demand Intake AND dp_value_stream_destination IS NOT EMPTY

transitions.name: Triage Bounce
transitions._hint_validators: comment field must not be empty (reason for bounce)

transitions.name: Hand to Architect
transitions._hint_validators: dp_type, T-Shirt-Sizing, dp_class_of_service, dp_run_grow_transform must be populated

transitions.name: Approve at Gate 2
transitions._hint_conditions: Project Role = dp_director_cs OR dp_director_itba OR dp_vp
transitions._hint_validators: dp_pain_score IS NOT EMPTY (i.e. A4 has fired)

transitions.name: Defer at Gate 2
transitions._hint_conditions: Project Role = dp_director_cs OR dp_director_itba OR dp_vp

transitions.name: Reject at Gate 2
transitions._hint_conditions: Project Role = dp_director_cs OR dp_director_itba OR dp_vp

_hint_after_creation: 1. Create a Workflow Scheme (POST /rest/api/3/workflowscheme) and add this workflow as the default.
2. Associate the scheme with project DGTLPROD (POST /rest/api/3/workflowscheme/project).
3. Verify by GET /rest/api/3/project/DGTLPROD/statuses — should list the 11 statuses above per issue type.
